allocations_shape_check.name: allocations_shape_check
allocations_shape_check.value: (kind = 'to_cause' and cause_id is not null and from_allocation_id is null and spending_entry_id is null and target_institute_id is null) or (kind = 'to_spending' and cause_id is not null and from_allocation_id is not null and spending_entry_id is not null and target_institute_id is null) or (kind = 'to_institute' and target_institute_id is not null and cause_id is null and from_allocation_id is null and spending_entry_id is null)

allocations_reversal_check.name: allocations_reversal_check
allocations_reversal_check.value: is_reversal = (reverses_allocation_id is not null) and (reason is null) = (not is_reversal) and (reason is null or (length(reason) between 1 and 500 and reason = btrim(reason)))

causes_dates_check.name: causes_dates_check
causes_dates_check.value: starts_on is null or ends_on is null or ends_on >= starts_on

causes_type_rules_check.name: causes_type_rules_check
causes_type_rules_check.value:
coalesce(
          (cause_type = 'campaign' and target_paisa is not null and ends_on is not null
            and target_period is null and stock_year_start_month is null)
          or (cause_type = 'ongoing' and ends_on is null
            and target_period in ('monthly', 'yearly') and stock_year_start_month is null)
          or (cause_type = 'yearly_stock' and ends_on is null
            and target_period is null and stock_year_start_month between 1 and 12),
          false
        )

donations_bank_reference_check.name: donations_bank_reference_check
donations_bank_reference_check.value: bank_reference is null or (length(bank_reference) between 1 and 120 and bank_reference = btrim(bank_reference) and bank_reference !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

donations_bank_guard_check.name: donations_bank_guard_check
donations_bank_guard_check.value: method <> 'bank_transfer' or (bank_account_id is not null and bank_reference is not null)

donations_source_check.name: donations_source_check
donations_source_check.value: (method = 'platform_transfer') = (source_allocation_id is not null) and (gateway_payment_id is null or method in ('card', 'jazzcash', 'easypaisa'))

donations_currency_check.name: donations_currency_check
donations_currency_check.value: currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' and amount_minor > 0 and ((currency = 'PKR' and amount_minor = amount_paisa and fx_rate is null) or (currency <> 'PKR' and fx_rate > 0))

donations_private_note_check.name: donations_private_note_check
donations_private_note_check.value: private_note is null or length(private_note) between 1 and 2000

donors_email_check.name: donors_email_check
donors_email_check.value: length(email) <= 254 and email = lower(btrim(email)) and email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$'

donors_text_check.name: donors_text_check
donors_text_check.value:
(legal_name is null or (length(legal_name) between 1 and 200 and legal_name = btrim(legal_name) and legal_name !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'))
        and (display_name is null or (length(display_name) between 1 and 80 and display_name = btrim(display_name) and display_name !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'))
        and (phone is null or phone ~ '^[+0-9][0-9 ()-]{4,31}$')

donors_reminder_check.name: donors_reminder_check
donors_reminder_check.value: not reminder_opt_in or reminder_opt_in_at is not null

donors_claim_check.name: donors_claim_check
donors_claim_check.value: claimed_at is null or user_id is not null

donors_erasure_check.name: donors_erasure_check
donors_erasure_check.value:
erased_at is null or (email is null and legal_name is null and phone is null
          and display_name is null and photo_media_id is null and profile_links = '[]'::jsonb
          and not profile_public and not reminder_opt_in)

institute_bank_accounts_for_donation_typ.name: institute_bank_accounts_for_donation_types_check
institute_bank_accounts_for_donation_typ.value: (cardinality(for_donation_types) > 0) AND (array_position(for_donation_types, NULL::text) IS NULL) AND (for_donation_types <@ ARRAY['zakat'::text, 'sadaqah'::text, 'general'::text])

institute_bank_accounts_check.name: institute_bank_accounts_check
institute_bank_accounts_check.value: (NULLIF(btrim(account_number), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) OR (NULLIF(btrim(iban), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)

media_read.name: media_read
media_read.using:
(select app.has_role('admin')) or (
  uploaded_by = (select app.current_user_id())
  and (select app.is_member() or app.has_role('donor'))
)

media_assets_check1.name: media_assets_check1
media_assets_check1.value:
(bytes > 0) AND (bytes <=
CASE
    WHEN (purpose = 'avatar'::text) THEN 60000
    WHEN (kind = 'image'::text) THEN 600000
    WHEN (kind = ANY (ARRAY['audio'::text, 'slides'::text])) THEN 10000000
    WHEN (kind = 'document'::text) THEN 5000000
    WHEN (kind = 'video'::text) THEN 25000000
    ELSE 0
END)

media_assets_check5.name: media_assets_check5
media_assets_check5.value: ((kind = 'youtube'::text) AND (youtube_id IS NOT NULL) AND (storage_key IS NULL) AND (mime_type IS NULL) AND (bytes IS NULL)) OR ((kind <> 'youtube'::text) AND (storage_key IS NOT NULL) AND (mime_type IS NOT NULL) AND (bytes IS NOT NULL) AND (youtube_id IS NULL))

receipt_email_jobs_attempts_check.name: receipt_email_jobs_attempts_check
receipt_email_jobs_attempts_check.value: attempts between 0 and 6 and (attempts = 0) = (first_attempt_at is null)

receipt_email_jobs_lease_check.name: receipt_email_jobs_lease_check
receipt_email_jobs_lease_check.value: (state = 'leased') = (claim_token is not null) and (claim_token is null) = (lease_expires_at is null)

receipt_email_jobs_terminal_check.name: receipt_email_jobs_terminal_check
receipt_email_jobs_terminal_check.value:
(state in ('sent', 'failed')) = (finished_at is not null)
        and (finished_at is null) = (to_email is not null)
        and (finished_at is null or snapshot is null)

receipt_email_jobs_error_check.name: receipt_email_jobs_error_check
receipt_email_jobs_error_check.value:
last_error is null or last_error in ('rate_limited', 'provider_unavailable', 'network_error',
          'configuration', 'provider_rejected', 'recipient_changed', 'donation_unavailable',
          'payload_changed', 'attempts_exhausted', 'retry_window_expired')

recurring_pledges_status_check.name: recurring_pledges_status_check
recurring_pledges_status_check.value: status in ('active', 'lapsed', 'cancelled') and (status = 'cancelled') = (cancelled_at is not null) and missed_periods >= 0

site_page_drafts_facts_check.name: site_page_drafts_facts_check
site_page_drafts_facts_check.value: facts is null or (slug = 'home' and app.valid_home_facts(facts))

site_pages_facts_check.name: site_pages_facts_check
site_pages_facts_check.value: facts is null or (slug = 'home' and app.valid_home_facts(facts))

trail_events_shape_check.name: trail_events_shape_check
trail_events_shape_check.value: (event_type = 'received' and cause_id is null and allocation_id is null and spending_entry_id is null and spending_report_id is null and reverses_event_id is null) or (event_type = 'allocated' and allocation_id is not null and spending_entry_id is null and spending_report_id is null and reverses_event_id is null) or (event_type = 'spent' and cause_id is not null and allocation_id is not null and spending_entry_id is not null and spending_report_id is null and reverses_event_id is null) or (event_type = 'reported' and cause_id is null and allocation_id is null and spending_entry_id is null and spending_report_id is not null and reverses_event_id is null) or (event_type = 'reversal' and reverses_event_id is not null and spending_report_id is null)

trail_events_reason_check.name: trail_events_reason_check
trail_events_reason_check.value: (reason is null) = (event_type <> 'reversal') and (reason is null or (length(reason) between 1 and 500 and reason = btrim(reason)))

trail_links_own_read.name: trail_links_own_read
trail_links_own_read.using: donor_id in (select app.my_donor_ids()) or (select app.has_role('admin')) or (select app.has_role('finance_officer'))

trail_links_revocation_check.name: trail_links_revocation_check
trail_links_revocation_check.value: (revoked_at is null) = (revoked_by is null) and (revoke_reason is null or (revoked_at is not null and length(revoke_reason) between 1 and 200 and revoke_reason !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'))

trail_links_expiry_check.name: trail_links_expiry_check
trail_links_expiry_check.value: expires_at is null or expires_at > created_at

user_read.name: user_read
user_read.using:
(id = (select app.current_user_id()) and status in ('active', 'left'))
  or (select app.has_role('admin'))

users_check.name: users_check
users_check.value: (email IS NOT NULL) OR (username IS NOT NULL)
